DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: All zombies gain +100% attack damage, +30% health, and +350% armor durability
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 所有僵尸的攻击力+100%，生命值+30%，防具耐久度+350%

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: All King gain +100% health, can grant armor to themselves and Gargantuars, with increased armor granting speed
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 所有国王僵尸的生命值+100%，可以为自己和巨人授勋，授勋的速度提升

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: Evil Potions maximum capacity is reduced, but initial quantity is significantly increased with faster spawn rate
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 邪恶药水数量上限降低，但是初始数量大幅提升，出现速度提升
出现墓碑位置有所不同

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: Some waves and dynamic spawning are modified, with certain plants disabled
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 部分波次和动态出怪有所不同，禁用部分植物
